boundary: This package reports package integrity, content review eligibility and official-geometry-dependent professional scoring as separate axes.

axes.supports_zh: 结构、双语、图件、GeoJSON、指标、矩阵和 manifest 已通过包内门禁。
axes.supports_en: Structure, bilingual files, figures, GeoJSON, metrics, matrices and manifest pass package gates.
axes.still_requires_zh: 官方边界、现场资料和专业判断仍需单独取得。
axes.still_requires_en: Official geometry, field records and professional judgement remain separate inputs.

axes.supports_zh: 组织方 polygon 缺口不阻断维护者和 Review Agent 对包内内容的评审。
axes.supports_en: An organiser polygon gap does not block maintainer and Review Agent content review of this package.
axes.still_requires_zh: 内容评审分数不等于现场绩效、专业签字或实施许可。
axes.still_requires_en: A content-review score does not establish field performance, professional sign-off or implementation permission.

axes.supports_zh: 正式专业评分轴仍保留在等待官方 SITE_BOUNDARY 和 KEY_AREA polygon 的状态。
axes.supports_en: The official-geometry-dependent professional scoring axis remains waiting for SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons.
axes.still_requires_zh: 补齐官方空间数据后，必须联动重算几何、指标、图纸和报告。
axes.still_requires_en: Official spatial data must trigger coordinated recalculation of geometry, metrics, drawings and reports.

human_label_zh: 机器门禁与内容评审就绪，正式专业评分资格等待官方空间数据
human_label_en: Package gates and content review are ready; formal professional scoring waits for official spatial data
